$Comment: The Horseman's Helm, one of the four plain pieces of his armour the Horseman's Hoard can pay, the Claim players see as his Boss Kill (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json and its hard twin): the finned black steel helm he has no head left to wear. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json), where it takes the head slot as the Jack Helm does, so either helm with his other three pieces makes the set's four. Its model is the Horseman's helm (Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Armor/) in its plain texture, and its icon is drawn from that model by tools/derive_art.py. CosmeticsToHide clears ears, hair, beard and face accessories, since the helm closes over the whole head. Its recipe is left out (it is never crafted) and its stats sit a step below the iron helm's, the way the Jack Helm's do, with one thing more: DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 3% harder with it on. Its flaming twin, Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Horseman_Helm, is the Hoard's stronger copy on the same model, in gold. Light is the ember glow it gives off. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent. Tags.ZigLevel asks for Defense 20 to wear it (the best level the player ever reached), behind MMO Skill Tree's Gear levels switch (Tags.ZigLevelFeature); gear a player already had when gear levels arrived keeps working for them, and a server owner frees or retunes it with a ZigLevel group gate in mods/ziggfreedcommon/use-gates.json.
